title: Refund lanes read RSL status and recommend for claims in audit
scope: Lane proposals apply to claims RSL has placed in audit, read RSL's claim status, and send the lane and undisputed amount to RSL as a recommendation through TAX-124

acceptance.text: Lane proposals record the RSL status they were made against and are not created for claims RSL already processed
No Vati record sets refund status, release or payment; wording says recommendation
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Bench tests across RSL status values

evidence.text: ADR-054. assurance.rules.rsl_claim_status records the status RSL's Online Refunds Application reports (TAX-111 codes, owner RSL; unknown codes not shown raw) in every lane body and in the new read-only Vati Lane Proposal.rsl_claim_status column ('not_reported' when RSL gives none). Claims RSL has processed, rejected or cancelled get no lane (checks and findings still run; run summary lane_withheld: rsl_claim_<status>); validate_lane refuses such a lane. When the decision is approved, rsl_outbound.store.rsl_claim_status_now reads RSL's status again and queues only the findings pack if RSL has decided the claim since; the lane_recommendation carries rsl_claim_status_at_proposal. Tests: assurance/test_rules 23 (every status value, unknown codes, decided claims refused); rsl_outbound/test_rules (recommendation withheld per status); bench test_rsl_intake_bench 10/10 across all six statuses and a missing one (lanes and column for audit_in_progress/pending/processing/unreported; none for processed/rejected/cancelled; status re-read before queuing).

validate_lane accepts only undisputed_status 'recommendation_for_refund_auditor' and refuses refund_status/release_amount/other-owner status fields; the outbound contract keeps FORBIDDEN_FIELDS (status, pay, release, offset, assess) and the new field is context only (tests/integration/test_rsl_sinks.py incl. status-setting fields refused). DocType description and message docstrings say recommendation; RSL sets status and pays. Grep of lane surfaces found no release/payment wording.

Fresh disposable site (verify-20261113t153306): install and two migrations ok (new column). Bench modules one by one: all OK except assistance (duplicate synthetic user, untouched) and reminders (fails identically on main on the same site). evidence_gaps 5/5 and rsl_outbound 9/9 after their lane fixtures gained the status and recommendation wording. Frappe-free backend 667 with only the Windows path-separator failure; contract 140, RSL sinks/sources, AI assurance 37 OK; ruff, mypy clean; validate.py clean. Hosted CI does not start (org spending limit).
